title: What's using the file
intro: If deleting or moving a file fails because it's in use, find the processes holding it here. Files can also be dropped onto the Argus window.
dropZone: Drop files or folders onto the window, or

error.notFound: Couldn't find the file or folder.

none: No accessible process was found using these files.

found.one: Found {count} process using these files or folders.
found.other: Found {count} processes using these files or folders.

service.one: The privileged service checked {count} file handle, including directory handles.
service.other: The privileged service checked {count} file handles, including directory handles.

local.one: Checked {count} file handle locally, including directory handles.
local.other: Checked {count} file handles locally, including directory handles.

incomplete: Results are incomplete. Inaccessible processes: {denied}; unreadable handles: {skipped}; timed-out queries: {timeouts}. {limit}
serviceHint: Enable the privileged service in Settings to check more system processes.

unchecked.one: Restart Manager couldn't check {count} more file, possibly because of permissions or a change to the file.
unchecked.other: Restart Manager couldn't check {count} more files, possibly because of permissions or changes to the files.

truncated: The folder has too many files; only the first {count} were checked.
footerHint: The handle query also finds folders in use as a working directory; protected processes may still be out of reach.
drop: Release to find the processes using these files
